name: Empagliflozin
route_note: oral tablet 10 or 25 mg once daily

discovery.note: A C-glucoside SGLT2 inhibitor in the gliflozin class descended from the natural product phlorizin.

tagline: A diabetes pill that turned out to protect the heart and kidneys
summary: Empagliflozin is an SGLT2 inhibitor that lowers blood glucose by making the kidneys excrete glucose in the urine. The 2015 EMPA-REG OUTCOME trial showed it reduced cardiovascular death, and later trials extended its use to heart failure and chronic kidney disease regardless of diabetes.
mechanism: The sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2, gene SLC5A2) in the early proximal tubule reabsorbs about 90% of glucose filtered by the kidney. Inhibiting it causes urinary loss of roughly 60–80 g of glucose per day, lowering blood glucose independently of insulin and producing a mild calorie deficit and osmotic diuresis.

Increased sodium delivery to the macula densa restores tubuloglomerular feedback and reduces glomerular hyperfiltration, which is thought to underlie the kidney protection seen in trials. Natriuresis, lower blood pressure, a shift toward ketone use and other haemodynamic and metabolic effects are proposed to explain heart-failure benefits that occur even without diabetes.
uses: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (adults and children 10 years and older)
Reduction of cardiovascular death in type 2 diabetes with established CVD
Heart failure across the range of ejection fraction
Chronic kidney disease at risk of progression

history.title: Approval
history.detail: The EU approves Jardiance in May 2014 and FDA in August 2014.

history.title: EMPA-REG OUTCOME
history.detail: Empagliflozin reduces cardiovascular death by 38% in type 2 diabetes with CVD (NEJM 2015).

history.title: Cardiovascular indication
history.detail: FDA approves Jardiance to reduce cardiovascular death, the first diabetes drug with such a claim.

history.title: EMPEROR-Reduced
history.detail: Empagliflozin reduces cardiovascular death or HF hospitalisation in HF with reduced ejection fraction.

history.title: EMPEROR-Preserved
history.detail: First positive major trial in HF with preserved ejection fraction; HF indications follow in 2021–2022.

history.title: EMPA-KIDNEY and CKD approval
history.detail: EMPA-KIDNEY shows reduced kidney progression or cardiovascular death; FDA approves the CKD indication in September 2023.

pk.metabolism: glucuronidation by UGT2B7, UGT1A3, UGT1A8, UGT1A9

serious: necrotising fasciitis of the perineum (Fournier's gangrene)

facts: Jardiance was the first diabetes drug labelled by FDA to reduce cardiovascular death (2016).
EMPEROR-Preserved was the first large trial to show clear benefit of any drug class in HF with preserved ejection fraction.

references.title: Zinman B et al. EMPA-REG OUTCOME (NEJM 2015)
